rawFindings.title: Incorrect calculation of text range for fixing indentation
rawFindings.explanation: The function 'report' calculates the range of text to be replaced for fixing indentation using incorrect subtraction of indentation characters and offsets, leading to inaccurate fixes if the leading tokens contain unexpected characters. The new calculation subtracts the counts from node.range ends but does not consider node.loc columns correctly, which may cause wrong text ranges for the fixer.
rawFindings.suggestion: Adjust the calculation of 'textRange' in 'report' to correctly compute the start and end offsets using node location columns and indentation character counts, ensuring ranges align with the indent characters to replace.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When there is additional whitespace or comments on the line, the fixer incorrectly replaces the wrong range, making the auto-fix invalid or damaging code.
